rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Communication Department's highlights dated 19 October 2022 style him 'Shri Mallikarjun Kharge, President-Elect, Indian National Congress'; Shri Surjewala introduces him (Hindi) as the newly elected AICC president.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Closing the briefing, Shri Surjewala says (Hindi) that Kharge will take charge of his office on the 26th and hold a press conference that day.
